title: The Problem: One URL, One Page

blocks.content: The Problem: One URL, One Page
Open the Daily Journal App right now.
1// Click "Run Code" to view the full project
1/* Daily Journal App — React Hooks edition css goes here */
Look at the URL in the address bar. It says something like this:
This is the only URL you'll see throughout the app — whether you're looking at the entry list or a single entry detail, the URL never changes.
That's a problem for real apps:

items: You can't share a link to the journal page.
You can't bookmark your current view.
You can't press the browser's back button and expect to go back to where you were.

blocks.content: From the browser's perspective, you've never left the one page. We're going to change that.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
